description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Visual Designer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our culture isn’t something people join, it’s something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.



We're looking for a Visual (Design Systems) Designer with exceptional visual design skills to support a large-scale Design System initiative for a leading enterprise software platform. This role is focused on visual exploration, design systems thinking, and crafting polished user interface experiences that can scale across complex products


You'll work closely with an established Design System team to help define and evolve the visual language of the platform. This is a highly collaborative role where you'll explore design directions, create high-fidelity concepts, evaluate design solutions, and help bridge brand expression with scalable system design.


Must Haves

  • 5+ years of experience in UX/UI, Product Design, or Visual Design roles with a strong emphasis on user interface design and visual craft.
  • Outstanding visual design portfolio demonstrating excellence in typography, color systems, spacing, hierarchy, layout, iconography, and interaction design.
  • Experience working within or contributing to design systems, with an understanding of how visual decisions scale across products and experiences.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise software, complex workflows, information-dense interfaces, and interaction patterns.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.1 AA, and experience incorporating accessibility considerations into visual design decisions
  • Comfort working in ambiguous environments, synthesizing inputs, forming design recommendations, and defending design rationale with stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with designers, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Experience working on enterprise SaaS products.
  • Previous involvement in Design System initiatives or component library evolution.
  • Experience conducting competitive visual analysis and translating insights into design recommendations.
  • Familiarity with Material UI (MUI) or other enterprise design system frameworks.



Key Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with the Design System team to explore and define future visual directions for enterprise software products.
  • Explore, iterate, and refine visual design directions across areas such as color, typography, spacing, elevation, iconography, and overall product aesthetics.
  • Create high-fidelity design concepts and prototypes that demonstrate how visual design decisions apply across real product workflows and use cases.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable visual patterns that can be incorporated into the broader Design System.
  • Support design evaluation activities by preparing assets, prototypes, and presentation materials for stakeholder reviews and user feedback sessions.
  • Collaborate with product designers, researchers, engineers, and brand partners to align visual design direction with user needs and business goals.
  • Help translate brand principles into practical, scalable Design System solutions that can be adopted across products,
  • Advocate for accessibility, consistency, and usability throughout the design process.
  • Contribute to a culture of design excellence through collaboration, critique, and thoughtful design discussion.

description:

This role is focused on driving multiple concurrent product transition, migration, and implementation projects while coordinating stakeholders across Product, Engineering, IT, Legal, Finance, Operations, and Implementation teams.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments, excels at managing competing priorities, and can serve as the central point of coordination across numerous workstreams. You will act as the organizational \"control tower,\" ensuring critical initiatives stay on track, dependencies are identified early, risks are mitigated, and teams remain aligned toward shared objectives.

Our client is a leading energy technology company focused on digitizing fuel operations through a single, real-time platform. Their software connects people, equipment, and facilities to provide enterprise-wide visibility and data-driven insights that fuel asset optimization, improve operational efficiency, and help organizations manage risk, maintenance, and fuel logistics more effectively.

  • Drive cross-functional programs involving Product, Engineering, IT, Legal, Finance, Operations, Training, and Implementation teams

Required Experience

  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience coordinating work across multiple business functions and departments
  • Ability to identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and process improvements across complex initiatives
  • Strong experience facilitating cross-functional collaboration and driving execution
  • Experience working with software development, product management, and engineering organizations
  • Technical acumen with a solid understanding of software development, infrastructure, and technology concepts
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities

description:

Junior Writer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.


Role Overview

As a Junior Writer, you will be responsible for adapting and localizing English content into portuguese - culturally relevant versions, ensuring narrative consistency, emotional depth, and audience engagement. You will work closely with editorial, production, and AI teams to refine scripts, monitor performance, and enhance content quality across the platform.


Key Responsibilities

1. Content Development & Adaptation

  • Review English show materials (audio/scripts) and prepare localization sheets and concept notes with strong cultural adaptation.
  • Adapt scripts using designated GenAI tools, ensuring proper structuring, tone, and inclusion of emotion tags where required.
  • Review and refine AI-generated translations to ensure alignment with editorial standards, cultural nuances, and narrative integrity.
  • Incorporate editorial and technical feedback to revise and deliver high-quality, polished scripts.
  • Deliver ~300 localized and AI-adapted scripts per month, adhering to timelines and quality benchmarks.


2. Quality Reviews & Continuous Improvement

  • Review published audio episodes and provide structured feedback on AI-generated adaptations.
  • Identify recurring issues in translation, tone, or storytelling and recommend improvements.
  • Analyze user comments and feedback to enhance content quality and relevance.

  • Suggest suitable voice-over artists based on character and project requirements
  • Ensure produced content aligns with creative intent and quality standards
  • Conduct quality checks on production samples and provide actionable feedback to ensure “first-time-right” output.


4. Promotion Support

  • Develop concepts and draft scripts for promotional content (10–60 minutes) aligned with series positioning and storytelling goals


5. AI-Driven Editorial Innovation & Tool Adoption

  • Demonstrate hands-on usage of AI tools to enhance editorial workflows, script development, research, adaptation, and content optimization.
  • Apply strong editorial judgment while leveraging GenAI tools to ensure narrative quality, factual consistency, cultural sensitivity, and platform standards.


Qualifications

  • Strong storytelling skills with an understanding of narrative structure, character development, and pacing.
  • Familiarity with AI-based writing or content adaptation tools is preferred

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance, Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Head of Compliance & MLRO to oversee the company's compliance and regulatory responsibilities in Brazil. This role will support the business in maintaining a strong compliance culture, managing regulatory relationships, and ensuring alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.


Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business.
  • Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations.
  • Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required.
  • Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities.
  • Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations.
  • Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions.
  • Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management.
  • Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization.
  • Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets.
  • Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred.
  • Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous.
  • Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial.
  • Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  • Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.


OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Visual Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Visual Designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our culture isn’t something people join, it’s something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.



We're looking for a Visual (Design Systems) Designer with exceptional visual design skills to support a large-scale Design System initiative for a leading enterprise software platform. This role is focused on visual exploration, design systems thinking, and crafting polished user interface experiences that can scale across complex products


You'll work closely with an established Design System team to help define and evolve the visual language of the platform. This is a highly collaborative role where you'll explore design directions, create high-fidelity concepts, evaluate design solutions, and help bridge brand expression with scalable system design.


Must Haves

  • 5+ years of experience in UX/UI, Product Design, or Visual Design roles with a strong emphasis on user interface design and visual craft.
  • Outstanding visual design portfolio demonstrating excellence in typography, color systems, spacing, hierarchy, layout, iconography, and interaction design.
  • Experience working within or contributing to design systems, with an understanding of how visual decisions scale across products and experiences.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise software, complex workflows, information-dense interfaces, and interaction patterns.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.1 AA, and experience incorporating accessibility considerations into visual design decisions
  • Comfort working in ambiguous environments, synthesizing inputs, forming design recommendations, and defending design rationale with stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with designers, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Experience working on enterprise SaaS products.
  • Previous involvement in Design System initiatives or component library evolution.
  • Experience conducting competitive visual analysis and translating insights into design recommendations.
  • Familiarity with Material UI (MUI) or other enterprise design system frameworks.



Key Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with the Design System team to explore and define future visual directions for enterprise software products.
  • Explore, iterate, and refine visual design directions across areas such as color, typography, spacing, elevation, iconography, and overall product aesthetics.
  • Create high-fidelity design concepts and prototypes that demonstrate how visual design decisions apply across real product workflows and use cases.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable visual patterns that can be incorporated into the broader Design System.
  • Support design evaluation activities by preparing assets, prototypes, and presentation materials for stakeholder reviews and user feedback sessions.
  • Collaborate with product designers, researchers, engineers, and brand partners to align visual design direction with user needs and business goals.
  • Help translate brand principles into practical, scalable Design System solutions that can be adopted across products,
  • Advocate for accessibility, consistency, and usability throughout the design process.
  • Contribute to a culture of design excellence through collaboration, critique, and thoughtful design discussion.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Support Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Theta Data

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


The Role

We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to be the front line of the customer experience at Theta Data. This is not a generic helpdesk role. Our customers are quantitative researchers, developers, and traders who ask technically sophisticated questions about financial data, APIs, and data integrity. You'll need to understand what they're asking and diagnose problems in depth.


Your primary responsibility is to monitor Intercom and Discord to identify, triage, and respond to customer issues as they come in. When you can resolve an issue or provide a working workaround, you do it. When you can't, write a clear, well-documented Jira ticket and escalate to Engineering with everything they need to act quickly, and track the ticket's progress until it's complete. We believe the most important feature is the one the customer already paid for. We take this promise seriously, and we want someone who will, too!


What You'll Do

  • Monitor Intercom and Discord and respond to incoming customer issues in a timely manner
  • Diagnose technical problems related to API behavior, data quality, authentication, request handling, and account set-up
  • Write and run Python scripts to reproduce issues and validate data against expected behavior
  • Make REST API calls to investigate and isolate bugs or unexpected responses
  • Provide workarounds and clear guidance to customers where possible
  • Write thorough, reproducible Jira tickets and escalate unresolved issues
  • Identify recurring issues and surface patterns to help prioritize fixes
  • Create and maintain internal documentation on common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps


What We're Looking For

Required

  • Experience working in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role
  • Comfort working with REST APIs, including reading documentation, making requests, and interpreting responses
  • Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data inspection, and reproducing issues
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and engineers
  • Detail-oriented and systematic approach to diagnosing problems
  • Weekend support rotation


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience with financial data APIs
  • Familiarity with financial data concepts (options, equities, market data, OHLCV, Greeks, etc.)
  • Familiarity with Jira or similar issue tracking tools
  • Experience with Intercom or similar support platforms
  • Exposure to SQL or database queries for data validation


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter; you will influence how we operate

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Support Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Theta Data

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


The Role

We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to be the front line of the customer experience at Theta Data. This is not a generic helpdesk role. Our customers are quantitative researchers, developers, and traders who ask technically sophisticated questions about financial data, APIs, and data integrity. You'll need to understand what they're asking and diagnose problems in depth.


Your primary responsibility is to monitor Intercom and Discord to identify, triage, and respond to customer issues as they come in. When you can resolve an issue or provide a working workaround, you do it. When you can't, write a clear, well-documented Jira ticket and escalate to Engineering with everything they need to act quickly, and track the ticket's progress until it's complete. We believe the most important feature is the one the customer already paid for. We take this promise seriously, and we want someone who will, too!


What You'll Do

  • Monitor Intercom and Discord and respond to incoming customer issues in a timely manner
  • Diagnose technical problems related to API behavior, data quality, authentication, request handling, and account set-up
  • Write and run Python scripts to reproduce issues and validate data against expected behavior
  • Make REST API calls to investigate and isolate bugs or unexpected responses
  • Provide workarounds and clear guidance to customers where possible
  • Write thorough, reproducible Jira tickets and escalate unresolved issues
  • Identify recurring issues and surface patterns to help prioritize fixes
  • Create and maintain internal documentation on common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps


What We're Looking For

Required

  • Experience working in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role
  • Comfort working with REST APIs, including reading documentation, making requests, and interpreting responses
  • Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data inspection, and reproducing issues
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and engineers
  • Detail-oriented and systematic approach to diagnosing problems
  • Weekend support rotation


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience with financial data APIs
  • Familiarity with financial data concepts (options, equities, market data, OHLCV, Greeks, etc.)
  • Familiarity with Jira or similar issue tracking tools
  • Experience with Intercom or similar support platforms
  • Exposure to SQL or database queries for data validation


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter; you will influence how we operate
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily
  • A role that rewards genuine curiosity about financial data and technical problem-solving

title: Head of Compliance, Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance, Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Head of Compliance & MLRO to oversee the company's compliance and regulatory responsibilities in Brazil. This role will support the business in maintaining a strong compliance culture, managing regulatory relationships, and ensuring alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.


Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business.
  • Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations.
  • Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required.
  • Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities.
  • Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations.
  • Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions.
  • Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management.
  • Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization.
  • Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets.
  • Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred.
  • Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous.
  • Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial.
  • Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  • Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.


OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a full-time, remote Project Manager with 5+ years of experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives within software and technology organizations. This role is focused on driving multiple concurrent product transition, migration, and implementation projects while coordinating stakeholders across Product, Engineering, IT, Legal, Finance, Operations, and Implementation teams.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments, excels at managing competing priorities, and can serve as the central point of coordination across numerous workstreams. You will act as the organizational \"control tower,\" ensuring critical initiatives stay on track, dependencies are identified early, risks are mitigated, and teams remain aligned toward shared objectives.

Our client is a leading energy technology company focused on digitizing fuel operations through a single, real-time platform. Their software connects people, equipment, and facilities to provide enterprise-wide visibility and data-driven insights that fuel asset optimization, improve operational efficiency, and help organizations manage risk, maintenance, and fuel logistics more effectively.


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the central coordinator for 15 concurrent projects, including product transitions, implementation initiatives, and product enhancements
  • Drive cross-functional programs involving Product, Engineering, IT, Legal, Finance, Operations, Training, and Implementation teams
  • Develop and maintain program-level roadmaps, timelines, and dependency tracking
  • Ensure legacy product retirement initiatives remain on schedule and aligned with business objectives
  • Coordinate customer transition activities, including internal readiness, legal requirements, implementation planning, and operational processes
  • Partner with IT and Engineering teams to ensure systems, infrastructure, and technical requirements are properly aligned
  • Work closely with Legal and Operations teams to support product migrations, compliance requirements, notifications, and transition planning
  • Track and manage action items across multiple stakeholders and departments
  • Facilitate prioritization discussions and ensure resources remain focused on the highest-impact initiatives
  • Proactively identify project risks and drive resolution before they impact delivery timelines
  • Provide executive-level visibility into program status, blockers, dependencies, and milestones
  • Support implementation and rollout planning to ensure successful adoption of new products and services
  • Collaborate with Scrum Masters, Product Managers, and Engineering teams while maintaining a broader program-level perspective
  • Establish and improve processes for managing large-scale, cross-functional initiatives
  • Drive accountability across teams and ensure commitments are completed on schedule


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in Program Management, Technical Program Management, Project Management, or Product Operations roles
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects in software or technology-focused organizations
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience coordinating work across multiple business functions and departments
  • Ability to identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and process improvements across complex initiatives
  • Strong experience facilitating cross-functional collaboration and driving execution
  • Experience working with software development, product management, and engineering organizations
  • Technical acumen with a solid understanding of software development, infrastructure, and technology concepts
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities
  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and maintain accountability across teams
  • Experience operating in fast-paced environments with competing priorities and evolving requirements


Preferred Experience

  • Experience managing product migrations, software implementations, or legacy system retirement programs
  • Experience using Kanban-based project management methodologies
  • Experience working with Product, Engineering, IT, Legal, Finance, and Operations teams
  • Background in SaaS, enterprise software, or technology-driven organizations
  • Experience with portfolio management, program governance, or PMO functions
  • Familiarity with Agile development environments
  • Experience using project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms
  • Experience supporting organizational change management initiatives
  • Experience working in highly cross-functional, matrixed environments


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions. Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Chef Corporativo Parceiro
description:

A Unox , líder global na produção de fornos de alta qualidade e orgulhosamente certificada como Great Place to Work® no Brasil, está procurando Chefs Corporativos para se juntar à nossa equipe de parceiros nacionais.


Nessa função, você será responsável por demonstrar, treinar e orientar clientes e parceiros sobre o uso eficiente das tecnologias da Unox , promovendo soluções inovadoras que otimizem processos e elevem a qualidade e rentabilidade das operações culinárias.

  • Apoiar a equipe comercial com insights técnicos e argumentos estratégicos;
  • Acompanhar tendências gastronômicas e propor soluções inovadoras;
  • Oferecer suporte pós-venda para garantir performance máxima dos produtos UNOX.

  • Conhecimento em fornos combinados e diferentes técnicas de cocção;

  • Boa comunicação interpessoal e habilidades de apresentação;
  • Proatividade e perfil mão na massa;
  • Desejável: Inglês Intermediário.

  • Atuação como embaixador da marca;

Por que Unox?

Inovação contínua : A Unox está na vanguarda da tecnologia e inovação, trabalhando em projetos pioneiros e desafiadores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho jovem e positivo promove a colaboração e valoriza as ideias de todos os nossos funcionários. Organizamos regularmente eventos da empresa para networking e formação de equipes com colegas.


Crescimento Profissional : A Unox investe no desenvolvimento de seus colaboradores por meio de programas de treinamento contínuo, coaching individual e oportunidades de carreira, garantindo constante crescimento pessoal e profissional.


O posto de trabalho está aberto a candidatos de todos os gêneros e identidades de gênero, em conformidade com os regulamentos atuais de igualdade de oportunidades.

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:


  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital


Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Arquiteto de soluções - IA Microsoft
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto de soluções - IA Microsoft em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Arquiteto de soluções - IA & Intelligent Applications


Estamos buscando um(a) profissional com foco em IA aplicada no Azure. Você vai atuar diretamente com clientes, liderando engajamentos técnicos de ponta a ponta: desde o design de arquitetura até a implantação em produção de soluções inteligentes com Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio e ecossistema Microsoft AI. O foco é remover bloqueios técnicos, acelerar adoção e garantir que as soluções de IA saiam do PoC para escala real.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência com Fundamentos de IA e LLMs: Entendimento sólido de como LLMs funcionam, como o tokens, contexto, temperatura, hallucination e grounding. - Experiência prática com prompt engineering: system prompts, few-shot, chain-of-thought e instrução estruturada. -Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura de IA: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agentes com tool use e orquestração de múltiplos agentes. - Familiaridade com avaliação de qualidade de modelos: métricas como relevância, fundamentação e coerência.
  • Experiência com Azure AI Foundry: Criação de projetos, deploy de modelos e configuração de endpoints. - Uso do model catalog, fine-tuning e avaliação de modelos dentro do Foundry. - Configuração de grounding com Azure AI Search (indexação, chunking, estratégias de retrieval). - Integração com Azure OpenAI Service e outros modelos disponíveis no Foundry.
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio: Experiência com criação de agentes no Copilot Studio na criação de tópicos, entidades, variáveis e fluxo conversacional. - Integração de agentes com fontes de conhecimento externas (SharePoint, sites, documentos). - Configuração de actions e conexão com Power Automate para automações a partir do agente. - Publicação e deployment de agentes em canais (Teams, web, outros)
  • Experiência com Arquitetura e Cloud: Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas orientadas a IA no Azure (AI Foundry + Search + Storage + Function/App Service). - Entendimento de segurança aplicada a IA: managed identity, RBAC, data residency, responsible AI. - Habilidade de comunicar arquiteturas técnicas para públicos técnicos e executivos.


Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions para CI/CD de soluções de IA (MLOps light);
  • Familiaridade com Python para prototipagem rápida, scripts de indexação ou integração com SDKs de IA;
  • Conhecimento de Azure Functions ou Logic Apps para automação serverless;
  • Experiência com Azure API Management (APIM) para expor e governar endpoints de IA;
  • Familiaridade com conectores customizados e extensões de agente (Copilot extensibility);
  • Conhecimento de Azure SQL, Cosmos DB ou PostgreSQL para persistência em soluções de IA;
  • Experiência com Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) ou containerização de modelos/aplicações;
  • Familiaridade com monitoramento de IA: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, logging de prompts/respostas;
  • Certificação AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate);
  • Certificação PL-100 / PL-200 (Power Platform);
  • Certificação AZ-204 (Azure Developer Associate);




Modelo de atuação: Home Office, mas precisa ter disponibilidade para viajar esporadicamente;

Contratação CLT


O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;



Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Procurement Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Procurement Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Lead Academic Book Procurement & Global Logistics (Brazil)

Location: Brazil (Remote/Hybrid)

Contract Type: Freelance / Consulting Engagement

Industry: Academic Publishing, Book Procurement, Supply Chain & Logistics


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced professional to lead the large-scale sourcing, procurement, and international logistics of used academic books from Brazil and other relevant markets. This role requires a well-connected individual with an extensive network across universities, libraries, wholesalers, distributors, liquidation partners, and academic book suppliers.

The ideal candidate will have proven experience handling high-volume book procurement projects and be capable of sourcing, purchasing, and exporting significant quantities of used academic books (100,000–200,000+ books) while ensuring compliance with all legal, customs, and export requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and establish relationships with universities, libraries, academic institutions, book wholesalers, distributors, and bulk book suppliers.
  • Source and procure used academic books in large volumes (100,000–200,000+ units).
  • Negotiate pricing, contracts, and procurement agreements with suppliers.
  • Manage end-to-end procurement operations, including supplier onboarding and inventory acquisition.
  • Coordinate domestic and international logistics, warehousing, transportation, and shipment planning.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian export regulations and destination-country import requirements.
  • Handle customs documentation, permits, licenses, and other legal formalities related to international book shipments.
  • Develop scalable procurement strategies to support ongoing global demand.
  • Monitor supplier performance, inventory availability, and delivery timelines.
  • Build and maintain a reliable network of procurement and logistics partners.


Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience in academic book procurement, publishing, library acquisitions, book distribution, or related industries.
  • Strong network of contacts within universities, libraries, wholesalers, distributors, and book resellers.
  • Demonstrated experience managing large-volume procurement projects.
  • Knowledge of international trade, customs procedures, export documentation, and freight logistics.
  • Experience shipping goods from Brazil to international destinations.
  • Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
  • Ability to independently manage complex procurement and logistics operations.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English preferred.


Preferred Experience

  • Experience sourcing used academic, educational, scientific, medical, legal, or technical books.
  • Existing relationships with logistics providers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and export specialists.
  • Experience handling multi-country procurement and distribution projects.
  • Background in publishing, library services, academic institutions, or book supply chains.


Project Scope

  • Initial target volume: 100,000–200,000+ used academic books
  • Procurement source: Brazil and relevant regional networks
  • Distribution: International shipment to designated countries
  • Engagement type: Project-based with potential for long-term collaboration


What We're Looking For

We are looking for a highly connected procurement professional who can leverage their network to source large quantities of used academic books, navigate legal and logistical requirements, and successfully deliver books to international destinations at scale.


Interested candidates should share:

  • Relevant procurement and logistics experience
  • Examples of similar projects completed
  • Existing supplier and procurement network details
  • Geographic coverage
  • Expected consulting/freelance rate
  • Availability to start

About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


The SAP BW Lead will be responsible for leading end to end SAP BW initiatives, including architecture, design, development, migration, and operational support across SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA landscapes. The role will also own real time and near real time data replication using SAP SLT, ensure performant analytics leveraging Native HANA modeling, and act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.

This is a hands on leadership role requiring deep technical expertise as well as team and delivery ownership.


Key Responsibilities:


Advanced English


• Lead design and implementation of SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA solutions including modeling, data acquisition, transformations, and reporting layers.


• Define and govern BW architecture standards, object reuse strategy, naming conventions, transport strategy, and performance benchmarks.


• Own delivery across implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support engagements.

Data Acquisition & Integration (SLT Focus)


• Design and manage real time and delta data replication from SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA to BW using SAP SLT.


• Ensure optimal data flow design covering ODP, SLT, and standard extractors, with reconciliation and monitoring frameworks.


• Work closely with Basis and source system teams to ensure stable and scalable replication setups.


SAP BW Modeling & Transformations:


o InfoObjects, ADSOs (Field based & InfoObject based)


o Composite Providers, Open ODS Views


o Transformations, DTPs, Process Chains


Design and optimize Native HANA objects, including:


o Calculation Views, Table Functions, SQL Script procedures

o CDS Views (where applicable)

• Leverage push down logic to HANA to improve query and load performance.


• Collaborate with BW and HANA teams to decide optimal BW vs Native HANA modeling strategy.


Reporting & Analytics:


Oversee reporting solutions using:


o BEx Queries / Analysis for Office / SAP BO / SAC (where applicable)


• Ensure reporting performance, semantic consistency, and business KPI alignment across domains (FI, CO, SD, MM, Supply Chain).


Migration & Modernization:


Lead BW on HANA / BW/4HANA conversion and migration programs, including:


o Readiness checks and simplification item handling


o Remediation of custom code and data models


o Data volume management and performance validation


• Support S/4HANA transformation programs from an analytics perspective.

Production Support & Governance

• Act as escalation point for production issues, SLA adherence, root cause analysis, and resolution.

• Ensure strong governance around transports (ChaRM), releases, incident/change management, and documentation.


Team & Stakeholder Leadership:


• Mentor and guide SAP BW developers and HANA modelers.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, architects, and program managers.

• Contribute to effort estimation, planning, and delivery commitments.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Procurement Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Lead Academic Book Procurement & Global Logistics (Brazil)

Location: Brazil (Remote/Hybrid)

Contract Type: Freelance / Consulting Engagement

Industry: Academic Publishing, Book Procurement, Supply Chain & Logistics


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced professional to lead the large-scale sourcing, procurement, and international logistics of used academic books from Brazil and other relevant markets. This role requires a well-connected individual with an extensive network across universities, libraries, wholesalers, distributors, liquidation partners, and academic book suppliers.

The ideal candidate will have proven experience handling high-volume book procurement projects and be capable of sourcing, purchasing, and exporting significant quantities of used academic books (100,000–200,000+ books) while ensuring compliance with all legal, customs, and export requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and establish relationships with universities, libraries, academic institutions, book wholesalers, distributors, and bulk book suppliers.
  • Source and procure used academic books in large volumes (100,000–200,000+ units).
  • Negotiate pricing, contracts, and procurement agreements with suppliers.
  • Manage end-to-end procurement operations, including supplier onboarding and inventory acquisition.
  • Coordinate domestic and international logistics, warehousing, transportation, and shipment planning.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian export regulations and destination-country import requirements.
  • Handle customs documentation, permits, licenses, and other legal formalities related to international book shipments.
  • Develop scalable procurement strategies to support ongoing global demand.
  • Monitor supplier performance, inventory availability, and delivery timelines.
  • Build and maintain a reliable network of procurement and logistics partners.


Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience in academic book procurement, publishing, library acquisitions, book distribution, or related industries.
  • Strong network of contacts within universities, libraries, wholesalers, distributors, and book resellers.
  • Demonstrated experience managing large-volume procurement projects.
  • Knowledge of international trade, customs procedures, export documentation, and freight logistics.
  • Experience shipping goods from Brazil to international destinations.
  • Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
  • Ability to independently manage complex procurement and logistics operations.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English preferred.


Preferred Experience

  • Experience sourcing used academic, educational, scientific, medical, legal, or technical books.
  • Existing relationships with logistics providers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and export specialists.
  • Experience handling multi-country procurement and distribution projects.
  • Background in publishing, library services, academic institutions, or book supply chains.


Project Scope

  • Initial target volume: 100,000–200,000+ used academic books
  • Procurement source: Brazil and relevant regional networks
  • Distribution: International shipment to designated countries
  • Engagement type: Project-based with potential for long-term collaboration


What We're Looking For

We are looking for a highly connected procurement professional who can leverage their network to source large quantities of used academic books, navigate legal and logistical requirements, and successfully deliver books to international destinations at scale.


Interested candidates should share:

  • Relevant procurement and logistics experience
  • Examples of similar projects completed
  • Existing supplier and procurement network details
  • Geographic coverage
  • Expected consulting/freelance rate
  • Availability to start

The SAP BW Lead will be responsible for leading end to end SAP BW initiatives, including architecture, design, development, migration, and operational support across SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA landscapes. The role will also own real time and near real time data replication using SAP SLT, ensure performant analytics leveraging Native HANA modeling, and act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.

This is a hands on leadership role requiring deep technical expertise as well as team and delivery ownership.


Key Responsibilities:


Advanced English


• Lead design and implementation of SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA solutions including modeling, data acquisition, transformations, and reporting layers.


• Define and govern BW architecture standards, object reuse strategy, naming conventions, transport strategy, and performance benchmarks.


• Own delivery across implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support engagements.

Data Acquisition & Integration (SLT Focus)


• Design and manage real time and delta data replication from SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA to BW using SAP SLT.


• Ensure optimal data flow design covering ODP, SLT, and standard extractors, with reconciliation and monitoring frameworks.


• Work closely with Basis and source system teams to ensure stable and scalable replication setups.


SAP BW Modeling & Transformations:


o InfoObjects, ADSOs (Field based & InfoObject based)


o Composite Providers, Open ODS Views


o Transformations, DTPs, Process Chains


Design and optimize Native HANA objects, including:


o Calculation Views, Table Functions, SQL Script procedures

o CDS Views (where applicable)

• Leverage push down logic to HANA to improve query and load performance.


• Collaborate with BW and HANA teams to decide optimal BW vs Native HANA modeling strategy.


Reporting & Analytics:


Oversee reporting solutions using:


o BEx Queries / Analysis for Office / SAP BO / SAC (where applicable)


• Ensure reporting performance, semantic consistency, and business KPI alignment across domains (FI, CO, SD, MM, Supply Chain).


Migration & Modernization:


Lead BW on HANA / BW/4HANA conversion and migration programs, including:


o Readiness checks and simplification item handling


o Remediation of custom code and data models


o Data volume management and performance validation


• Support S/4HANA transformation programs from an analytics perspective.

Production Support & Governance

• Act as escalation point for production issues, SLA adherence, root cause analysis, and resolution.

• Ensure strong governance around transports (ChaRM), releases, incident/change management, and documentation.


Team & Stakeholder Leadership:


• Mentor and guide SAP BW developers and HANA modelers.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, architects, and program managers.

• Contribute to effort estimation, planning, and delivery commitments.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.   • Experiência com ServiceNow .

Advanced English

title: Procurement Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Procurement Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Lead Academic Book Procurement & Global Logistics (Brazil)

Location: Brazil (Remote/Hybrid)

Contract Type: Freelance / Consulting Engagement

Industry: Academic Publishing, Book Procurement, Supply Chain & Logistics


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced professional to lead the large-scale sourcing, procurement, and international logistics of used academic books from Brazil and other relevant markets. This role requires a well-connected individual with an extensive network across universities, libraries, wholesalers, distributors, liquidation partners, and academic book suppliers.

The ideal candidate will have proven experience handling high-volume book procurement projects and be capable of sourcing, purchasing, and exporting significant quantities of used academic books (100,000–200,000+ books) while ensuring compliance with all legal, customs, and export requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and establish relationships with universities, libraries, academic institutions, book wholesalers, distributors, and bulk book suppliers.
  • Source and procure used academic books in large volumes (100,000–200,000+ units).
  • Negotiate pricing, contracts, and procurement agreements with suppliers.
  • Manage end-to-end procurement operations, including supplier onboarding and inventory acquisition.
  • Coordinate domestic and international logistics, warehousing, transportation, and shipment planning.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian export regulations and destination-country import requirements.
  • Handle customs documentation, permits, licenses, and other legal formalities related to international book shipments.
  • Develop scalable procurement strategies to support ongoing global demand.
  • Monitor supplier performance, inventory availability, and delivery timelines.
  • Build and maintain a reliable network of procurement and logistics partners.


Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience in academic book procurement, publishing, library acquisitions, book distribution, or related industries.
  • Strong network of contacts within universities, libraries, wholesalers, distributors, and book resellers.
  • Demonstrated experience managing large-volume procurement projects.
  • Knowledge of international trade, customs procedures, export documentation, and freight logistics.
  • Experience shipping goods from Brazil to international destinations.
  • Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
  • Ability to independently manage complex procurement and logistics operations.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English preferred.


Preferred Experience

  • Experience sourcing used academic, educational, scientific, medical, legal, or technical books.
  • Existing relationships with logistics providers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and export specialists.
  • Experience handling multi-country procurement and distribution projects.
  • Background in publishing, library services, academic institutions, or book supply chains.


Project Scope

  • Initial target volume: 100,000–200,000+ used academic books
  • Procurement source: Brazil and relevant regional networks
  • Distribution: International shipment to designated countries
  • Engagement type: Project-based with potential for long-term collaboration


What We're Looking For

We are looking for a highly connected procurement professional who can leverage their network to source large quantities of used academic books, navigate legal and logistical requirements, and successfully deliver books to international destinations at scale.


Interested candidates should share:

  • Relevant procurement and logistics experience
  • Examples of similar projects completed
  • Existing supplier and procurement network details
  • Geographic coverage
  • Expected consulting/freelance rate
  • Availability to start

title: Data Tech Lead
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Tech Lead em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Oportunidade de atuação em projeto — Tech Lead de Dados e AI | Azure & Microsoft Fabric


Sobre a DataEX:

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA, Microsoft, AWS e Databricks partner, atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos a inovação, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a qualidade de vida, com incentivos para certificações e bem-estar


Contexto do projeto:

Oportunidade para atuação como Tech Lead de Dados & IA, apoiando tecnicamente iniciativas estratégicas de dados, analytics e inteligência artificial em clientes da DataEX. A atuação terá foco na orientação técnica de squads e equipes de delivery, contribuindo para a definição de arquiteturas, evolução de padrões técnicos, governança e qualidade das entregas, com forte utilização do ecossistema Microsoft, especialmente Azure e Microsoft Fabric.


Buscamos um profissional com sólida experiência em arquitetura e engenharia de dados, visão consultiva e capacidade de atuar de forma transversal junto a times multidisciplinares, apoiando decisões técnicas e promovendo boas práticas em diferentes contextos de projeto.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar como referência técnica para projetos de dados, analytics e AI desenvolvidos em stack Microsoft.
  • Apoiar squads e equipes de delivery na definição e revisão de arquiteturas de solução.
  • Remover impedimentos técnicos durante a execução dos projetos.
  • Garantir aderência a padrões técnicos, boas práticas de engenharia, segurança, governança e qualidade.
  • Revisar entregáveis técnicos, arquiteturas, pipelines, modelos de dados, integrações e componentes de plataforma.
  • Apoiar decisões relacionadas a Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Data Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Engineering, Analytics e AI.
  • Contribuir para a evolução dos padrões internos de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, documentação e operação.
  • Apoiar na criação de aceleradores, frameworks, templates e componentes reutilizáveis para aumentar produtividade e padronização das entregas.
  • Mentorar profissionais de diferentes níveis de senioridade, incluindo pessoas em desenvolvimento técnico, consultores, engenheiros de dados, arquitetos e especialistas.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente propostas, discovery, assessments e discussões com clientes quando necessário.
  • Atuar em conjunto com lideranças de delivery, arquitetura, governança, segurança e gestão de projetos.
  • Promover cultura de qualidade, colaboração, documentação e melhoria contínua.

Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência sólida em projetos de dados, analytics ou AI utilizando tecnologias Microsoft.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Azure , incluindo serviços de dados, segurança, identidade, redes e administração de ambientes cloud.
  • Experiência prática com Microsoft Fabric , incluindo conceitos de Lakehouse, Warehouse, Pipelines, Notebooks, OneLake, Power BI e governança da plataforma.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de dados moderna, incluindo Data Lake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Medallion Architecture, ELT/ETL e integração de dados.
  • Experiência com Azure Data Factory , Synapse Analytics , Databricks , Azure SQL , ADLS Gen2 , Power BI ou tecnologias equivalentes no ecossistema Microsoft.
  • Conhecimento em segurança no Azure, incluindo RBAC, Managed Identities, Key Vault, redes, Private Endpoints e boas práticas de segregação de ambientes.
  • Vivência com governança de dados, catálogo, linhagem, classificação, políticas e Microsoft Purview.
  • Conhecimento de IaC , preferencialmente com Terraform, Bicep ou ARM Templates.
  • Experiência com práticas de DevOps , versionamento, esteiras de CI/CD, Git, Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions.
  • Capacidade de revisar código, pipelines, arquiteturas, documentação técnica e padrões de entrega.
  • Conhecimento aplicado em práticas de qualidade, observabilidade, monitoramento, logging, testes e operação de soluções de dados.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações Microsoft, como Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Data Engineer, Fabric Analytics Engineer, Power BI Data Analyst ou Security Engineer.
  • Experiência prévia em consultoria.
  • Experiência com definição de landing zones de dados em Azure.
  • Vivência em projetos com AI, Generative AI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Machine Learning ou MLOps.
  • Experiência com FinOps, gestão de custos cloud e otimização de workloads.
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de governança, segurança e conformidade, como LGPD, ISO 27001, SOC 2 ou similares.
  • Experiência em comunidades técnicas, chapters, guildas ou centros de excelência.

A IBBRA Full Family Office é uma consultoria patrimonial 360º. Nosso propósito é ser para as famílias Brasileiras, um agente de mudança cultural em torno do patrimônio, fomentando emancipação e a realização de objetivos


Buscamos para nossa equipe pessoas dispostas a mudar a cultura patrimonial das famílias brasileiras enquanto se desenvolvem, estruram-se e alcançam novos horizontes.


O executivo de vendas irá atuar no desenvolvimento e gestão da carteira de clientes de alto patrimônio, conduzindo o relacionamento comercial, identificando oportunidades de negócio e assegurando uma experiência consultiva e integrada ao longo de toda a jornada comercial do cliente.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com o cliente, sendo o principal contato e conselheiro de confiança, prestando consultoria em disponibilidade total e permanente à família atendida.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, estratégica e contínua na jornada patrimonial
  • Atrair, desenvolver e gerir carteira de clientes de alta renda, com foco em crescimento e retenção
  • Implementar e monitorar estratégias de planejamento patrimonial abrangentes (investimentos, sucessão, proteção e gestão orçamentária), assegurando aderência aos objetivos familiares
  • Supervisionar carteiras de investimentos e a evolução patrimonial, propondo ajustes conforme perfil de risco e cenário econômico
  • Conduzir análises financeiras aprofundadas para otimização e alavancagem patrimonial
  • Coordenar ações multidisciplinares com advogados, contadores e outros especialistas
  • Coletar e analisar dados financeiros e contextuais, gerando inteligência para tomada de decisão
  • Promover educação financeira e apoiar a autonomia dos clientes e suas famílias
  • Atuar com postura ética, fiduciária e independente, em conformidade com as regulamentações


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Economia, Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para PL/SR Analista Funcional Salesforce em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7° ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília!


Sobre a vaga:

Estamos em busca de profissionais para atuar como Pessoa Administradora de CRM | Salesforce, com experiência em Salesforce Sales Cloud e/ou Service Cloud, para impulsionar a evolução das nossas operações de vendas, atendimento e relacionamento com clientes. Essas pessoas serão responsáveis pela construção e evolução de funis de vendas, jornadas de clientes e esteiras de atendimento, com forte foco em automação, escalabilidade, experiência do cliente e canais digitais. Buscamos pessoas com visão analítica, perfil colaborativo e capacidade de transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções escaláveis dentro do ecossistema Salesforce.


Responsabilidades:

  • Administrar, sustentar e evoluir a plataforma Salesforce, com foco em Sales Cloud e/ou Service Cloud;
  • Configurar e manter objetos customizados, campos, record types, page layouts, validation rules, perfis, permission sets e regras de compartilhamento;
  • Desenvolver e otimizar automações utilizando Salesforce Flow;
  • Construir e evoluir funis de vendas, jornadas comerciais e esteiras de atendimento;
  • Criar e manter relatórios, dashboards e indicadores operacionais e gerenciais;
  • Atuar na implementação e evolução de canais digitais de atendimento, incluindo Chatbots, WhatsApp, Omnichannel, Web Chat e Messaging;
  • Configurar filas, roteamentos, distribuição e priorização de atendimentos;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de negócio no levantamento de requisitos e implementação de melhorias;
  • Identificar oportunidades de automação, otimização de processos e ganho de eficiência operacional;
  • Garantir governança, organização e qualidade das informações dentro do CRM;
  • Criar e manter documentação funcional e técnica das soluções implementadas;
  • Apoiar treinamentos e oferecer suporte aos usuários da plataforma, promovendo maior adoção e uso eficiente do Salesforce.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Ciência da Computação, Administração, Processos Gerenciais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada com Salesforce Sales Cloud e/ou Service;
  • Experiência com Salesforce Flow (Screen, Record-Triggered e Scheduled Flows);
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados Salesforce (objetos, relacionamentos, sharing model e segurança);
  • Experiência na construção de relatórios e dashboards para acompanhamento de indicadores;
  • Certificações em Salesforce (Platform Administrator e/ou Platform App Builder);
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura e escrita técnica.


Diferencial ou Diferenciais:

  • Experiência anterior em Bancos, Instituições financeiras e/ou Instituições de pagamento;
  • Certificações Salesforce (Sales Cloud Consultant e/ou Service Cloud Consultant);
  • Vivência com métricas operacionais, indicadores comerciais e experiência do cliente (CX);
  • Experiência em projetos de transformação digital e melhoria contínua de processos;
  • Conhecimento em LLM aplicado a CRM.


Benefícios e Incentivos:

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;
