title: Analista SAP Solution Manager / ChaRM
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista SAP Solution Manager / ChaRM em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender uma multinacional global do segmento de Oil & Gas , em um ambiente tecnológico robusto e internacional, com atuação em Cloud ERP e foco em Application Change Management para ambientes SAP .

A pessoa profissional fará parte de um time global, atuando com suporte técnico-operacional , gestão de mudanças , transportes SAP , resolução de chamados e interação diária com equipes técnicas e funcionais de diferentes regiões.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar com Application Change Management em ambientes SAP .
  • Utilizar SAP Solution Manager, ChaRM, Focused Build e STMS para controle e movimentação de mudanças.
  • Apoiar transportes SAP, janelas de migração, change freeze , upgrades e system refresh .
  • Resolver tickets, requests, incidentes e troubleshooting relacionados à gestão de mudanças.
  • Interagir diariamente com times globais técnicos, funcionais e de projetos.
  • Contribuir com melhorias em processos de suporte, governança e estabilidade operacional.
  • Atuar em modelo global Follow The Sun — FTS , conforme necessidade da operação.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com SAP Solution Manager / SolMan .
  • Experiência com SAP ChaRM — Change Request Management .
  • Conhecimento em SAP Focused Build .
  • Conhecimento em STMS / SAP Transport Management System .
  • Vivência com suporte, sustentação, AMS, tickets, requests ou troubleshooting em ambientes SAP.
  • Experiência com gestão de mudanças, release management ou transportes SAP .
  • Experiência com ServiceNow .
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Office e SharePoint .
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente para comunicação com times globais.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em horário alinhado ao fuso de Houston.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento em SAP BASIS .
  • Vivência com SAP RISE ou ambientes SAP Cloud .
  • Conhecimento em LiveCompare .
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em ServiceNow .
  • Experiência com scripting ou automação.
  • Vivência em times ágeis.
  • Experiência em ambientes globais ou multiculturais.

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

CLT

title: Data Tech Lead
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Tech Lead em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Oportunidade de atuação em projeto — Tech Lead de Dados e AI | Azure & Microsoft Fabric


Sobre a DataEX:

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA, Microsoft, AWS e Databricks partner, atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos a inovação, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a qualidade de vida, com incentivos para certificações e bem-estar


Contexto do projeto:

Oportunidade para atuação como Tech Lead de Dados & IA, apoiando tecnicamente iniciativas estratégicas de dados, analytics e inteligência artificial em clientes da DataEX. A atuação terá foco na orientação técnica de squads e equipes de delivery, contribuindo para a definição de arquiteturas, evolução de padrões técnicos, governança e qualidade das entregas, com forte utilização do ecossistema Microsoft, especialmente Azure e Microsoft Fabric.


Buscamos um profissional com sólida experiência em arquitetura e engenharia de dados, visão consultiva e capacidade de atuar de forma transversal junto a times multidisciplinares, apoiando decisões técnicas e promovendo boas práticas em diferentes contextos de projeto.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar como referência técnica para projetos de dados, analytics e AI desenvolvidos em stack Microsoft.
  • Apoiar squads e equipes de delivery na definição e revisão de arquiteturas de solução.
  • Remover impedimentos técnicos durante a execução dos projetos.
  • Garantir aderência a padrões técnicos, boas práticas de engenharia, segurança, governança e qualidade.
  • Revisar entregáveis técnicos, arquiteturas, pipelines, modelos de dados, integrações e componentes de plataforma.
  • Apoiar decisões relacionadas a Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Data Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Engineering, Analytics e AI.
  • Contribuir para a evolução dos padrões internos de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, documentação e operação.
  • Apoiar na criação de aceleradores, frameworks, templates e componentes reutilizáveis para aumentar produtividade e padronização das entregas.
  • Mentorar profissionais de diferentes níveis de senioridade, incluindo pessoas em desenvolvimento técnico, consultores, engenheiros de dados, arquitetos e especialistas.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente propostas, discovery, assessments e discussões com clientes quando necessário.
  • Atuar em conjunto com lideranças de delivery, arquitetura, governança, segurança e gestão de projetos.
  • Promover cultura de qualidade, colaboração, documentação e melhoria contínua.

Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência sólida em projetos de dados, analytics ou AI utilizando tecnologias Microsoft.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Azure , incluindo serviços de dados, segurança, identidade, redes e administração de ambientes cloud.
  • Experiência prática com Microsoft Fabric , incluindo conceitos de Lakehouse, Warehouse, Pipelines, Notebooks, OneLake, Power BI e governança da plataforma.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de dados moderna, incluindo Data Lake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Medallion Architecture, ELT/ETL e integração de dados.
  • Experiência com Azure Data Factory , Synapse Analytics , Databricks , Azure SQL , ADLS Gen2 , Power BI ou tecnologias equivalentes no ecossistema Microsoft.
  • Conhecimento em segurança no Azure, incluindo RBAC, Managed Identities, Key Vault, redes, Private Endpoints e boas práticas de segregação de ambientes.
  • Vivência com governança de dados, catálogo, linhagem, classificação, políticas e Microsoft Purview.
  • Conhecimento de IaC , preferencialmente com Terraform, Bicep ou ARM Templates.
  • Experiência com práticas de DevOps , versionamento, esteiras de CI/CD, Git, Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions.
  • Capacidade de revisar código, pipelines, arquiteturas, documentação técnica e padrões de entrega.
  • Conhecimento aplicado em práticas de qualidade, observabilidade, monitoramento, logging, testes e operação de soluções de dados.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações Microsoft, como Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Data Engineer, Fabric Analytics Engineer, Power BI Data Analyst ou Security Engineer.
  • Experiência prévia em consultoria.
  • Experiência com definição de landing zones de dados em Azure.
  • Vivência em projetos com AI, Generative AI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Machine Learning ou MLOps.
  • Experiência com FinOps, gestão de custos cloud e otimização de workloads.
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de governança, segurança e conformidade, como LGPD, ISO 27001, SOC 2 ou similares.
  • Experiência em comunidades técnicas, chapters, guildas ou centros de excelência.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Solutions Architect em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Solutions Architect


Compensation: $6,800–$7,800 USD/month (depending on experience)

Engagement Type: Full-Time Contractor

Duration: 6–7 months with potential extension into a long-term support phase

Allocation: 100% Dedicated Engagement

Location: Remote (Americas) with periodic travel throughout the Americas and occasional travel to Europe.


About the Opportunity


Our client is a premium international hospitality organization operating a portfolio of luxury properties across North America, Latin America, and Europe. As part of a major data modernization initiative, they are building a centralized data platform that will consolidate operational, financial, guest, marketing, and commercial data from dozens of business-critical systems into a modern Microsoft Fabric environment.


They are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to serve as the primary delivery lead for a large-scale enterprise integration program. This individual will work directly with executive stakeholders, business leaders, technology vendors, and engineering teams to define integration strategies, align business requirements, and drive successful execution across a complex multi-system ecosystem.


This role combines solution architecture, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and delivery leadership, making it ideal for someone who enjoys bridging business objectives with technical implementation.


What You'll Do


  • Lead requirements discovery workshops with stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Sales, Marketing, CRM, and Business Intelligence teams.
  • Translate business objectives into scalable data integration and architecture solutions.
  • Serve as the primary client-facing delivery lead alongside a Fractional vCTO.
  • Coordinate with third-party software vendors to obtain integration requirements, negotiate technical specifications, and resolve implementation blockers.
  • Establish and maintain data requirements for each source system throughout the engagement lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with downstream analytics and modeling partners to define data warehouse consumption requirements.
  • Drive project planning, status reporting, stakeholder communications, and executive updates.
  • Produce key discovery-phase deliverables, including source system assessments, integration recommendations, implementation roadmaps, and vendor evaluations.
  • Help shape architecture decisions for a modern enterprise data platform built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure technologies.


What We're Looking For


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Data Architecture, or Enterprise Integration leadership roles.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale data integration initiatives involving numerous business systems and stakeholders.
  • Hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, or comparable cloud data platforms.
  • Strong background facilitating requirements gathering with executive stakeholders and operational leaders.
  • Experience working directly with third-party SaaS vendors to define and negotiate integration approaches.
  • Deep understanding of data warehouse architecture, governance, data contracts, and scalable ingestion patterns.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Professional-level English proficiency.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience delivering technology solutions within hospitality, retail, multi-location, or franchise-based organizations.
  • Familiarity with hospitality technology ecosystems, property management systems, POS platforms, CRM solutions, HRIS platforms, or reservation systems.
  • Consulting experience with a systems integrator, Microsoft partner, advisory firm, or enterprise consulting organization.
  • Microsoft certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, Fabric Analytics Engineer, or similar.
  • Spanish and/or Italian language skills are highly valued.


Technical Environment


The engagement leverages a modern Microsoft data stack, including:

  • Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, OneLake)
  • Azure ecosystem services
  • REST, SOAP, SFTP, and CDC integration patterns
  • Enterprise SaaS and hospitality platforms
  • Large-scale data ingestion and warehouse architectures


Team Structure


You will report directly to the engagement's Fractional vCTO and collaborate with a senior delivery team that includes Data Engineering, Backend/DevOps, and hospitality domain specialists. Together, the team is responsible for delivering a high-impact enterprise data platform that will support strategic decision-making across a global hospitality operation.


Why Join?


This is a unique opportunity to lead a highly visible enterprise transformation initiative for a sophisticated international organization. You'll work directly with senior leadership, influence architecture decisions, and help build a modern data foundation that will power business operations across multiple countries and brands.

title: QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us


Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.


At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.


Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.


Role Overview


As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.


Key Responsibilities


1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)

  • Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script.
  • Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards.
  • Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.


2. Script-to-Audio Alignment

  • Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression.
  • Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.


3. Technical & Creative Accuracy

  • Check audio for:
  • Voice clarity and consistency
  • Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness
  • Background noise or distortions
  • Timing and pacing issues
  • Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files
  • Grammatically incorrect words/sentences
  • Physical noise of voice artist
  • Abrupt cut / jerk
  • Sibilance
  • Fumble / mumble


4. Vendor & Artist Coordination

  • Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.


  • Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.


5. QC Documentation & Tracking

  • Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level.
  • Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content).
  • Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.


6. Pre-Release Quality Checks

  • Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform.
  • Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.


7. Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality.
  • Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.


8. Process Improvement

  • Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies.
  • Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows.
  • Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience
  • Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology


9. Volume & Deadline Management

  • Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines.
  • Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.


10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

  • Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns
  • Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress
  • Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation
  • Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses
  • Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes
  • Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery


Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.


Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.


Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics.
  • Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred.
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus.
  • Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content.
  • Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

  • Experiência com suporte e monitoramento de aplicações.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas.


Idioma

title: QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us


Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.


At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.


Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.


Role Overview


As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.


Key Responsibilities


1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)

  • Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script.
  • Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards.
  • Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.


2. Script-to-Audio Alignment

  • Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression.
  • Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.


3. Technical & Creative Accuracy

  • Check audio for:
  • Voice clarity and consistency
  • Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness
  • Background noise or distortions
  • Timing and pacing issues
  • Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files
  • Grammatically incorrect words/sentences
  • Physical noise of voice artist
  • Abrupt cut / jerk
  • Sibilance
  • Fumble / mumble


4. Vendor & Artist Coordination

  • Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.


  • Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.


5. QC Documentation & Tracking

  • Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level.
  • Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content).
  • Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.


6. Pre-Release Quality Checks

  • Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform.
  • Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.


7. Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality.
  • Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.


8. Process Improvement

  • Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies.
  • Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows.
  • Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience
  • Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology


9. Volume & Deadline Management

  • Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines.
  • Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.


10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

  • Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns
  • Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress
  • Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation
  • Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses
  • Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes
  • Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery


Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.


Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.


Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics.
  • Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred.
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus.
  • Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content.
  • Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

description:

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade .

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que estamos buscando

Um(a) profissional com perfil técnico, analítico e colaborativo para atuar no desenvolvimento, suporte e monitoramento de integrações utilizando MOVEit e SWIFT, em um ambiente dinâmico e global.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Solutions Architect em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Solutions Architect


Compensation: $6,800–$7,800 USD/month (depending on experience)

Engagement Type: Full-Time Contractor

Duration: 6–7 months with potential extension into a long-term support phase

Allocation: 100% Dedicated Engagement

Location: Remote (Americas) with periodic travel throughout the Americas and occasional travel to Europe.


About the Opportunity


Our client is a premium international hospitality organization operating a portfolio of luxury properties across North America, Latin America, and Europe. As part of a major data modernization initiative, they are building a centralized data platform that will consolidate operational, financial, guest, marketing, and commercial data from dozens of business-critical systems into a modern Microsoft Fabric environment.


They are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to serve as the primary delivery lead for a large-scale enterprise integration program. This individual will work directly with executive stakeholders, business leaders, technology vendors, and engineering teams to define integration strategies, align business requirements, and drive successful execution across a complex multi-system ecosystem.


This role combines solution architecture, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and delivery leadership, making it ideal for someone who enjoys bridging business objectives with technical implementation.


What You'll Do


  • Lead requirements discovery workshops with stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Sales, Marketing, CRM, and Business Intelligence teams.
  • Translate business objectives into scalable data integration and architecture solutions.
  • Serve as the primary client-facing delivery lead alongside a Fractional vCTO.
  • Coordinate with third-party software vendors to obtain integration requirements, negotiate technical specifications, and resolve implementation blockers.
  • Establish and maintain data requirements for each source system throughout the engagement lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with downstream analytics and modeling partners to define data warehouse consumption requirements.
  • Drive project planning, status reporting, stakeholder communications, and executive updates.
  • Produce key discovery-phase deliverables, including source system assessments, integration recommendations, implementation roadmaps, and vendor evaluations.
  • Help shape architecture decisions for a modern enterprise data platform built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure technologies.


What We're Looking For


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Data Architecture, or Enterprise Integration leadership roles.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale data integration initiatives involving numerous business systems and stakeholders.
  • Hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, or comparable cloud data platforms.
  • Strong background facilitating requirements gathering with executive stakeholders and operational leaders.
  • Experience working directly with third-party SaaS vendors to define and negotiate integration approaches.
  • Deep understanding of data warehouse architecture, governance, data contracts, and scalable ingestion patterns.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Professional-level English proficiency.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience delivering technology solutions within hospitality, retail, multi-location, or franchise-based organizations.
  • Familiarity with hospitality technology ecosystems, property management systems, POS platforms, CRM solutions, HRIS platforms, or reservation systems.
  • Consulting experience with a systems integrator, Microsoft partner, advisory firm, or enterprise consulting organization.
  • Microsoft certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, Fabric Analytics Engineer, or similar.
  • Spanish and/or Italian language skills are highly valued.


Technical Environment


The engagement leverages a modern Microsoft data stack, including:

  • Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, OneLake)
  • Azure ecosystem services
  • REST, SOAP, SFTP, and CDC integration patterns
  • Enterprise SaaS and hospitality platforms
  • Large-scale data ingestion and warehouse architectures


Team Structure


You will report directly to the engagement's Fractional vCTO and collaborate with a senior delivery team that includes Data Engineering, Backend/DevOps, and hospitality domain specialists. Together, the team is responsible for delivering a high-impact enterprise data platform that will support strategic decision-making across a global hospitality operation.


Why Join?


This is a unique opportunity to lead a highly visible enterprise transformation initiative for a sophisticated international organization. You'll work directly with senior leadership, influence architecture decisions, and help build a modern data foundation that will power business operations across multiple countries and brands.

title: QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us


Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.


At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.


Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.


Role Overview


As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.


Key Responsibilities


1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)

  • Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script.
  • Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards.
  • Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.


2. Script-to-Audio Alignment

  • Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression.
  • Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.


3. Technical & Creative Accuracy

  • Check audio for:
  • Voice clarity and consistency
  • Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness
  • Background noise or distortions
  • Timing and pacing issues
  • Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files
  • Grammatically incorrect words/sentences
  • Physical noise of voice artist
  • Abrupt cut / jerk
  • Sibilance
  • Fumble / mumble


4. Vendor & Artist Coordination

  • Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.


  • Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.


5. QC Documentation & Tracking

  • Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level.
  • Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content).
  • Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.


6. Pre-Release Quality Checks

  • Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform.
  • Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.


7. Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality.
  • Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.


8. Process Improvement

  • Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies.
  • Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows.
  • Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience
  • Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology


9. Volume & Deadline Management

  • Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines.
  • Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.


10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

  • Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns
  • Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress
  • Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation
  • Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses
  • Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes
  • Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery


Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.


Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.


Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics.
  • Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred.
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus.
  • Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content.
  • Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Full Stack Pleno em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações web em PHP, utilizando Laravel e Vue.js.
  • Implementar e manter integrações entre sistemas e APIs de terceiros.
  • Desenvolver funcionalidades voltadas para dashboards, relatórios e módulos financeiros.
  • Implementar e manter automações e fluxos operacionais.
  • Trabalhar com banco de dados MySQL, garantindo a otimização de consultas.
  • Participar do refinamento técnico das demandas e da análise e implementação de novas funcionalidades.
  • Garantir qualidade, padronização e organização do código.
  • Realizar manutenção e evolução da infraestrutura de desenvolvimento utilizando Docker.
  • Apoiar na identificação de melhorias e correções, colaborando com a equipe na evolução contínua dos sistemas.


QUALIFICAÇÕES:

  • Experiência sólida com PHP;
  • Experiência com Laravel;
  • Conhecimento em Vue.js;
  • Experiência com Tailwind CSS;
  • Conhecimento em MySQL;
  • Experiência no consumo e integração de APIs REST;
  • Conhecimento em Git;
  • Conhecimento em Docker;
  • Conhecimento em Redis;
  • Boa capacidade de organização e resolução de problemas;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e em ambiente remoto;


  • Diferenciais: experiência com N8N, automações e integração entre sistemas, Webhooks, filas e processamento assíncrono, vivência com dashboards e sistemas de BI, e conhecimento em ambientes de alta integração entre plataformas.


COMPETÊNCIAS:

  • PROATIVIDADE E COMPROMETIMENTO
  • AUTONOMIA NA EXECUÇÃO
  • RESOLUÇÃO DE PROBLEMAS
  • ATENÇÃO AOS DETALHES
  • ORGANIZAÇÃO E PADRONIZAÇÃO DE CÓDIGO
  • COLABORAÇÃO E TRABALHO EM EQUIPE


SALÁRIO:

  • A combinar
  • Bônus trimestral - Vale a partir do segundo Trimestre dentro da empresa.


TIPO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:

  • A prestação de serviço será feita no Regime PJ.
  • 100% Home Office


COMO FUNCIONA O TRABALHO:

  • Nossa comunicação é feita pelo discord, o candidato aprovado tem que estar disponível na plataforma para responder e se comunicar. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • Usamos o ClickUp para gerenciar as atividades da equipe. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • O candidato selecionado terá um período de três meses para ganhar experiência na empresa antes de ser efetivado na vaga

title: Especialista Python/IA (Inglês Avançado)
description:

O que buscamos:


Profissional de nível Especialista que atue com (Python/IA).

Construir um Centro de Comando de Confiabilidade (Reliability Command Center) centralizado, proporcionando uma visão unificada da saúde dos sistemas, riscos e indicadores de confiabilidade em diferentes serviços e ambientes.

* Evolução contínua baseada em feedback.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

* Experiência em desenvolvimento Backend ou Full Stack.

* Histórico comprovado na construção e sustentação de sistemas complexos em ambiente de produção.

* Forte domínio de Python.

* Experiência no desenvolvimento de: Aplicações orientadas a dados; APIs robustas e escaláveis.

* Excelente capacidade analítica e visão de produto.

* Habilidade para transformar requisitos ambíguos em soluções práticas e funcionais.

* Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA, como: Cursor; Claude; GitHub Copilot; Ferramentas similares.

Diferenciais

* React;

* Angular;

* Vue.js ou similares.

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;

title: DataOps Engineer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para DataOps Engineer (Relocation to Portugal) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems. With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation. Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Minimum 2/3 years of experience as a DataOps Engineer;
  • Hands-on experience creating, automating, and maintaining data pipelines;
  • Experience working with DevOps practices and cloud environments;
  • English level B2 or higher;
  • Availability to relocate to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Solutions Architect em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Solutions Architect


Compensation: $6,800–$7,800 USD/month (depending on experience)

Engagement Type: Full-Time Contractor

Duration: 6–7 months with potential extension into a long-term support phase

Allocation: 100% Dedicated Engagement

Location: Remote (Americas) with periodic travel throughout the Americas and occasional travel to Europe.


About the Opportunity


Our client is a premium international hospitality organization operating a portfolio of luxury properties across North America, Latin America, and Europe. As part of a major data modernization initiative, they are building a centralized data platform that will consolidate operational, financial, guest, marketing, and commercial data from dozens of business-critical systems into a modern Microsoft Fabric environment.


They are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to serve as the primary delivery lead for a large-scale enterprise integration program. This individual will work directly with executive stakeholders, business leaders, technology vendors, and engineering teams to define integration strategies, align business requirements, and drive successful execution across a complex multi-system ecosystem.


This role combines solution architecture, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and delivery leadership, making it ideal for someone who enjoys bridging business objectives with technical implementation.


What You'll Do


  • Lead requirements discovery workshops with stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Sales, Marketing, CRM, and Business Intelligence teams.
  • Translate business objectives into scalable data integration and architecture solutions.
  • Serve as the primary client-facing delivery lead alongside a Fractional vCTO.
  • Coordinate with third-party software vendors to obtain integration requirements, negotiate technical specifications, and resolve implementation blockers.
  • Establish and maintain data requirements for each source system throughout the engagement lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with downstream analytics and modeling partners to define data warehouse consumption requirements.
  • Drive project planning, status reporting, stakeholder communications, and executive updates.
  • Produce key discovery-phase deliverables, including source system assessments, integration recommendations, implementation roadmaps, and vendor evaluations.
  • Help shape architecture decisions for a modern enterprise data platform built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure technologies.


What We're Looking For


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Data Architecture, or Enterprise Integration leadership roles.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale data integration initiatives involving numerous business systems and stakeholders.
  • Hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, or comparable cloud data platforms.
  • Strong background facilitating requirements gathering with executive stakeholders and operational leaders.
  • Experience working directly with third-party SaaS vendors to define and negotiate integration approaches.
  • Deep understanding of data warehouse architecture, governance, data contracts, and scalable ingestion patterns.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Professional-level English proficiency.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience delivering technology solutions within hospitality, retail, multi-location, or franchise-based organizations.
  • Familiarity with hospitality technology ecosystems, property management systems, POS platforms, CRM solutions, HRIS platforms, or reservation systems.
  • Consulting experience with a systems integrator, Microsoft partner, advisory firm, or enterprise consulting organization.
  • Microsoft certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, Fabric Analytics Engineer, or similar.
  • Spanish and/or Italian language skills are highly valued.


Technical Environment


The engagement leverages a modern Microsoft data stack, including:

  • Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, OneLake)
  • Azure ecosystem services
  • REST, SOAP, SFTP, and CDC integration patterns
  • Enterprise SaaS and hospitality platforms
  • Large-scale data ingestion and warehouse architectures


Team Structure


You will report directly to the engagement's Fractional vCTO and collaborate with a senior delivery team that includes Data Engineering, Backend/DevOps, and hospitality domain specialists. Together, the team is responsible for delivering a high-impact enterprise data platform that will support strategic decision-making across a global hospitality operation.


Why Join?


This is a unique opportunity to lead a highly visible enterprise transformation initiative for a sophisticated international organization. You'll work directly with senior leadership, influence architecture decisions, and help build a modern data foundation that will power business operations across multiple countries and brands.

title: QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us


Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.


At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.


Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.


Role Overview


As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.


Key Responsibilities


1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)

  • Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script.
  • Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards.
  • Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.


2. Script-to-Audio Alignment

  • Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression.
  • Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.


3. Technical & Creative Accuracy

  • Check audio for:
  • Voice clarity and consistency
  • Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness
  • Background noise or distortions
  • Timing and pacing issues
  • Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files
  • Grammatically incorrect words/sentences
  • Physical noise of voice artist
  • Abrupt cut / jerk
  • Sibilance
  • Fumble / mumble


4. Vendor & Artist Coordination

  • Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.


  • Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.


5. QC Documentation & Tracking

  • Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level.
  • Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content).
  • Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.


6. Pre-Release Quality Checks

  • Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform.
  • Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.


7. Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality.
  • Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.


8. Process Improvement

  • Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies.
  • Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows.
  • Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience
  • Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology


9. Volume & Deadline Management

  • Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines.
  • Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.


10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

  • Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns
  • Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress
  • Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation
  • Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses
  • Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes
  • Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery


Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.


Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.


Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics.
  • Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred.
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus.
  • Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content.
  • Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization.


Employment Type : Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)


WHY JOIN OUR SOLUTION ARCHITECT TEAM?

  • You will work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms.
  • You will help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across Sisense environments.
  • You will collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success to shape best practices and improve the platform.
  • You will influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements.


IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

  • Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for Sisense deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues.
  • Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations.
  • Perform load testing, interpret results, and provide strategic recommendations for scaling, performance, and resource optimization.
  • Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments.
  • Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities.
  • Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.


WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED… SO FAR:

  • 5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect.
  • Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS / GKE.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix.
  • Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB (or another NoSQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting.
  • Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries.
  • Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS.
  • Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus.
  • Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders.


HOW YOU’LL RAMP:

  • By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes.
  • By Day 60: Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities, troubleshoot escalations, and support customer architecture reviews.
  • By Day 90: Own complex technical engagements end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement.

title: Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil/Remote

Contract: Permanent / Freelance

Experience Level: Senior

Language: English and Portuguese



Mission Overview

We are looking for a Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced automation solutions within distribution and logistics environments.

You will act as a key System Engineer , bridging operational needs with cutting-edge technologies such as robotics, RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems), and machine vision systems to drive efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments and enjoys combining technical expertise, data analysis, and project leadership to transform warehouse operations.


Key Responsibilities

System Design & Implementation

  • Design and deploy automated warehouse systems (AS/RS, conveyors, AGVs, robotic picking solutions)
  • Integrate RTLS solutions for real-time tracking of assets and inventory
  • Lead end-to-end system architecture aligned with operational requirements

Technical Optimization & Performance

  • Analyze workflows and system performance to identify bottlenecks
  • Implement data-driven improvements to maximize throughput and efficiency
  • Optimize warehouse execution systems (WES), warehouse management systems (WMS), and automation tools

Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor and ensure high availability of automation systems (robotics, sensors, vision systems)
  • Diagnose and resolve system issues across hardware and software layers
  • Maintain system documentation and continuous improvement processes

Project Management & Delivery

  • Lead or contribute to automation projects from concept to deployment
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (operations, IT, engineering)
  • Ensure minimal disruption to live operations during implementation

Training & Change Management

  • Support operational teams in adopting new technologies
  • Provide training and documentation for system usage and best practices

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all systems comply with safety standards and industry regulations
  • Contribute to improving workplace safety and ergonomics


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in warehouse automation, system engineering, or industrial automation
  • Proven experience with RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems)
  • Strong background in machine vision systems
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • WMS / WES systems
  • Robotics, AGVs, or automated material handling systems
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems, sensors, and control systems
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly (nationally and/or internationally) to support project deployments and client sites


Nice to Have

  • Experience in project management (PMP or equivalent is a plus)
  • Knowledge of programming/scripting (Python or similar)
  • Experience with data analysis and performance optimization
  • Background in industrial engineering, robotics, or logistics systems
  • Portuguese knowledge


Key Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • System-level thinking and architecture mindset
  • Ability to work in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

title: TikTok Creator Community Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para TikTok Creator Community Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Zainith Agency is a marketing agency specializing in TikTok Shop onboarding, paid advertising, and consulting for branding and web page design. With over 6 years of experience managing successful eCommerce brands, we help businesses grow through tailored digital marketing strategies and strategic affiliate partnerships. Our services also include design and affiliate curation, making us a trusted partner for brands looking to enhance their social commerce presence.


Job Description


Zainith Agency is looking for a TikTok Shop Creator Community Manager to join our team remotely. While this position is remote, Zainith Agency is headquartered in New York City, USA.


IMPORTANT: Applications from candidates who are not fluent in English, do not give their resume in English, or do not have proven TikTok Shop knowledge will be immediately disqualified. No exceptions.


The Community Manager will operate as the primary point of contact with top TikTok Shop creators making content for Zainith Agency’s clients. The focus of this role is to build and maintain strong relationships with creators and grow Zainith Agency’s discord community by offering training, biweekly calls, contests and prizes, and more!


You will be responsible for:

  • Managing creators on TikTok Shop Seller Center and discord orWhatsApp groups (10-12)
  • Meeting one-on-one with top creators and building relationships
  • Hosting contests, workshops, office hours, etc. within discord to keep creators engaged
  • Recruiting TikTok Shop affiliates to join and be active in our discord community
  • Growing the number of creators within the community as well as the collective GMV driven by the community through TAP links


The ideal candidate has a proven track record in account management, eCommerce, and client satisfaction. You should have multiple examples of going above and beyond to meet client expectations.


Responsibilities

  • Meet targets for discord membership growth and GMV driven
  • Host biweekly call to keep creators engaged and driven
  • Moderate discord or WhatsApp chats and engage regularly with members
  • Answer questions related to TikTok Shop and Zainith Agency’s services for creators
  • Manage and promote affiliate contests with prizes and payouts
  • Add and remove client brands from affiliate group and ensure top creators are being onboarded to the community


Requirements

  • MUST have proven experience with TikTok Shop (Seller Central, Ads Manager, affiliates, etc)
  • Self-starter comfortable with developing a program from scratch with little direction or oversight.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken at a professional level)
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent listening, negotiation, and presentation abilities
  • Previous eCommerce experience
  • Ability to manage multiple client accounts with sharp attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and communicate with stakeholders at all levels, including executives
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection that supports live video meetings with screen sharing



About Zainith Agency

Zainith Agency is a New York–based marketing agency dedicated to helping clients achieve peak growth on TikTok Shop. The “zenith” represents the highest point, and Zainith is committed to scaling and maintaining sales growth for every client.


We've worked with several high revenue powerhouses such as Momofuku, Obvi, Primal Harvest, Kinobody, and more!


We foster a culture of excellence, flexibility, and growth.


Benefits include:

  • Paid time off
  • Flexible health insurance subsidy
  • Employee perks and ongoing professional development


If you are fluent in English, and bring proven TikTok Shop expertise, we’d love to see your application!

title: Gerente de Projetos-Equipamentos Comerciais
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de Projetos-Equipamentos Comerciais em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1. Sobre a SolutionMall

A SolutionMall é uma plataforma global B2B de entrega de soluções, atendendo necessidades de edifícios comerciais, hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, lavanderias, hospitais, escolas, instalações industriais, infraestrutura e projetos baseados em equipamentos comerciais.

Apoiamos os clientes na análise de requisitos, seleção de produtos, comparação de soluções, coordenação com fornecedores, suporte a RFQ, coordenação de cotações, entrega e acompanhamento de projetos.

Na área de equipamentos comerciais, a SolutionMall cobre produtos e soluções relacionados a:

  • Sistemas de ar-condicionado comercial
  • Máquinas de lavanderia comercial
  • Aquecedores de água comerciais
  • Equipamentos de cozinha comercial
  • Equipamentos para restaurantes e hotéis
  • Sistemas de refrigeração comercial
  • Iluminação comercial
  • Displays comerciais e equipamentos de exibição
  • Equipamentos para supermercados e lojas
  • Peças, acessórios e materiais de instalação
  • Soluções integradas para projetos comerciais


2. Visão geral da função

Estamos procurando um Gerente de Projetos – Equipamentos Comerciais, Brasil para apoiar o desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de projetos da SolutionMall no mercado brasileiro.

Esta função é adequada para profissionais com experiência em gestão de projetos, vendas técnicas, desenvolvimento de negócios, equipamentos comerciais, HVAC, lavanderia comercial, cozinha comercial, hotelaria, supermercados, facilities, instalação de equipamentos ou projetos B2B.

O foco principal é entender as necessidades dos clientes, acompanhar oportunidades de projetos, coordenar RFQs e cotações, apoiar a seleção de equipamentos comerciais e ajudar no avanço de projetos com clientes, fornecedores, instaladores e partes interessadas.

Este é um cargo voltado para projetos B2B, com foco em equipamentos comerciais, seleção técnica, coordenação de fornecedores, comunicação com clientes e desenvolvimento de projetos no Brasil.


3. Principais responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar projetos de equipamentos comerciais no Brasil, incluindo hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, lavanderias, hospitais, escolas, edifícios comerciais e instalações industriais.
  • Comunicar-se com clientes, fornecedores, instaladores, distribuidores, equipes de procurement, consultores e partes interessadas de projetos.
  • Apoiar a seleção de equipamentos como ar-condicionado comercial, lavadoras comerciais, aquecedores de água, equipamentos de cozinha, iluminação comercial e displays comerciais.

4. Requisitos

Requisitos principais

Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em uma ou mais das seguintes áreas:

  • Gestão de projetos de equipamentos comerciais
  • Vendas técnicas B2B
  • Equipamentos de HVAC ou ar-condicionado comercial
  • Lavanderia comercial
  • Equipamentos de cozinha comercial
  • Aquecedores de água comerciais
  • Iluminação comercial

  • Equipamentos para hotéis, restaurantes ou supermercados
  • Facility management
  • Coordenação de RFQ e cotações
  • Desenvolvimento de fornecedores ou canais

Capacidade de compreender requisitos de clientes, especificações técnicas, seleção de produtos, cenários de aplicação, acompanhamento de RFQ e comunicação de projetos.

Boas habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar com clientes, fornecedores, instaladores, distribuidores, consultores e equipes de procurement no Brasil.

Domínio do português. A capacidade de se comunicar em inglês será considerada uma vantagem.

Preferido

  • Experiência com projetos de hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, lavanderias, hospitais, escolas ou edifícios comerciais
  • Experiência com HVAC comercial, lavanderia comercial, cozinha comercial, refrigeração, iluminação ou displays comerciais
  • Conhecimento de instalação, manutenção, seleção técnica ou operação de equipamentos comerciais
  • Experiência em acompanhamento de RFQ, coordenação de cotações, suporte a projetos ou desenvolvimento de oportunidades comerciais
  • Recursos de clientes, instaladores, distribuidores ou fornecedores no Brasil


5. Modelo de trabalho

Este cargo é focado no acompanhamento de projetos e desenvolvimento de negócios no mercado brasileiro.

As principais áreas de trabalho incluem:

  • Comunicação com clientes
  • Acompanhamento de oportunidades de projetos
  • Coordenação de RFQ e cotações
  • Seleção de equipamentos comerciais
  • Comparação de soluções e fornecedores
  • Comunicação técnica e comercial
  • Feedback do mercado local
  • Apoio ao avanço dos projetos

Este cargo é especialmente adequado para profissionais com experiência ou acesso a projetos comerciais, hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, lavanderias, HVAC, cozinha comercial, iluminação, displays comerciais, distribuidores ou instaladores no Brasil.


6. Remuneração e benefícios

A SolutionMall oferece um modelo de remuneração orientado a resultados, baseado no escopo da função, experiência do candidato, capacidade de desenvolvimento de clientes, acompanhamento de projetos e contribuição comercial.

Os detalhes podem ser discutidos durante o processo de entrevista, de acordo com a experiência, os recursos locais, a compreensão técnica e a capacidade de acompanhamento de projetos do candidato.


7. Como se candidatar

Candidate-se com uma breve apresentação destacando sua experiência em:

  • Equipamentos comerciais
  • HVAC ou ar-condicionado comercial
  • Lavanderia comercial
  • Aquecedores de água comerciais
  • Cozinha comercial
  • Iluminação comercial
  • Displays comerciais
  • Hotéis, restaurantes ou supermercados
  • Gestão de projetos B2B

  • Mercado brasileiro de equipamentos comerciais
